decision.title: Retrieval Topology
decision.summary: Best fit for high-audit systems that need deterministic routing plus graph, lexical, and vector retrieval tools.

domain_invariants: Answers must resolve to source-backed evidence before being returned.
The primary topology must preserve explicit relationships between domain entities.
Compliance-critical flows must be deterministic, reviewable, and replayable.
Agentic search must be bounded by workflow controls and must not silently mutate source-of-truth state.
Bounded contexts must communicate through explicit interfaces or domain events.

candidate_topologies.name: hybrid_rag
candidate_topologies.label: Hybrid RAG
candidate_topologies.fit: Good baseline for document search that needs lexical, vector, and metadata filtering.
risks: Still limited when explicit relationships are the primary domain object.
Can hide bounded-context ownership behind retrieval plumbing.

candidate_topologies.name: workflow_routed_hybrid_graphrag
candidate_topologies.label: Workflow-Routed Hybrid GraphRAG
candidate_topologies.fit: Best fit for high-audit systems that need deterministic routing plus graph, lexical, and vector retrieval tools.
risks: Requires evaluation of both retrieval quality and orchestration behavior.

candidate_topologies.name: graphrag
candidate_topologies.label: GraphRAG
candidate_topologies.fit: Strong for entity-heavy domains where relationships, traversal, and lineage are first-class.
risks: Can overfit if the domain does not have stable entities or relationships.

candidate_topologies.name: relational_domain_model_first
candidate_topologies.label: Relational / Domain-Model-First
candidate_topologies.fit: Best when source-of-truth transactions, aggregates, and ownership matter more than generative retrieval.
risks: Can become too rigid when the corpus is unstructured and fast-changing.

candidate_topologies.name: agentic_search
candidate_topologies.label: Agentic Search
candidate_topologies.fit: Useful for exploratory research across tools, APIs, and changing information sources.
risks: Dangerous as the primary path for compliance-critical answers.

candidate_topologies.name: naive_vector_rag
candidate_topologies.label: Naive Vector RAG
candidate_topologies.fit: Good for simple, self-contained document lookup where semantic similarity is enough.
risks: Can lose source lineage when answers require cross-document joins.
Easy for downstream agents to overuse because it is simple to scaffold.

required_invariants: Answers must resolve to source-backed evidence before being returned.
The primary topology must preserve explicit relationships between domain entities.
Compliance-critical flows must be deterministic, reviewable, and replayable.
Agentic search must be bounded by workflow controls and must not silently mutate source-of-truth state.
Bounded contexts must communicate through explicit interfaces or domain events.
